items.html: And behold, the third aspect is that ZA will have nine Sefirot. And it was explained there that from the lower third of the Tifferet of Arich Anpin, the Hochma of ZA is made, and from the Yesod of Arich Anpin, the Bina of ZA is made. And behold, since the Daat is not yet in him in its proper repair, as above, because he is not yet fit to procreate, it thus follows that also the Mochin of Hochma are not complete and fully repaired, since the Daat, which couples the Mochin of Hochma with the Mochin of Bina, is not in him; so the repair of the Mochin of Hochma was not completed entirely. And what is now repaired in the nursing with a more complete repair is the Mochin of Bina alone, and the Hochma is also repaired by itself.
